stock.description: Headquartered in Kwai Chung, Hong Kong, Daido Group Limited operates as an investment holding company with a diversified business portfolio. Its primary focus lies in delivering cold storage and comprehensive logistical support services across both the People's Republic of China and Hong Kong. The company segments its operations into three main areas: Cold Storage and Related Services, Trading of Food and Beverage, and Money Lending Services. Within its cold storage division, Daido Group provides an extensive array of warehousing and logistics solutions, including general and refrigerated storage, freight management, cargo transportation, towing, container devanning, loading, packaging, repackaging, and various other value-added services. The food and beverage segment is responsible for the importation, exportation, and both primary and secondary distribution of food and drink products, alongside associated support services. Additionally, the group manages Urban Mart, an online retail platform offering daily necessities, produces herbal tea under its "Attitude Planet" brand, and provides money lending services.
